On this event, i0 is reached and G = Gi0 has m edges and the following simultaneous properties. (i) Every vertex has degree (1 ± n−c)np, and every two distinct vertices have (1 ± n−c)D common neighbors. (ii) For every vertex u and 3 ≤ j ≤ r0, the number of embeddings of a fixed labeled cycle Cj into the link G[NG(u)] is (1 ± n−c)Dj. 4 (iii) For every template (H, I) with v(H) ≤ H0 and every injection ψ : I → [n], the following two bounds hold. If S(H′, I) ≥ 1 for every same-root subtemplate H′, then XH,I,ψ(G) ≤ (1 + log n)C0 S(H, I). (2.4) If nv(H)−|J|pe(H)−e(H[J]) ≤ 1 for every I ⊆ J ⊆ V (H), then XH,I,ψ(G) ≤ (1 + log n)C0 .
